All microbatches execute forward passes through the pipeline first\n    - Then all microbatches execute backward passes in reverse order\n\n    Args:\n        model: LlamaForCausalLM instance\n        inputs: List of microbatch input_ids tensors, each of shape [microbatch, seq_len]\n        targets: List of microbatch target_ids tensors, each of shape [microbatch, seq_len]\n        device: torch device to use\n        dtype: torch dtype for computations\n\n    The model's transformer layers are partitioned across ranks in a balanced way.\n    Forward communication sends hidden states [microbatch, seq_len, hidden_size].\n    Backward communication sends gradients of the same shape.\n    Loss is computed on the last rank and scaled by the number of microbatches.\n    \"\"\"\n    rank = dist.get_rank()\n    world_size = dist.get_world_size()\n\n    # Extract model components\n    embed_tokens = model.model.embed_tokens\n    layers = list(model.model.layers)\n    norm = model.model.norm\n    lm_head = model.lm_head\n    hidden_size = model.config.hidden_size\n\n    # Partition transformer layers across ranks in a balanced way\n    num_layers = len(layers)\n    base_layers_per_rank = num_layers // world_size\n    remainder_layers = num_layers % world_size\n\n    # Calculate which layers this rank is responsible for\n    rank_layer_start = rank * base_layers_per_rank + min(rank, remainder_layers)\n    rank_layer_count = base_layers_per_rank + (1 if rank < remainder_layers else 0)\n    rank_layer_end = rank_layer_start + rank_layer_count\n    rank_layers = layers[rank_layer_start:rank_layer_end]\n\n    num_microbatches = len(inputs)\n\n    # ===== FORWARD PHASE =====\n    # Store forward activations for use during backward phase\n    forward_activations = []\n    losses = []\n\n    for microbatch_idx, (input_ids, target_ids) in enumerate(zip(inputs, targets)):\n        # Prepare inputs - 1, microbatch_size, seq_len,\n                                                   hidden_size, device, dtype)\n\n        # Save input hidden states for backward phase\n        hidden_states_input = hidden_states.detach().clone()\n\n        # Forward through this rank's layers (detached - no gradient tracking in forward phase)\n        hidden_states = hidden_states.detach()\n        for layer in rank_layers:\n            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states, attention_mask=None)[0]\n\n        # Save output hidden states for backward phase\n        hidden_states_output = hidden_states.detach().clone()\n        forward_activations.append((hidden_states_input, hidden_states_output))\n\n        if rank == world_size - 1:\n            # Last rank: compute cross-entropy loss and scale by num_microbatches\n            hidden_states_normalized = norm(hidden_states)\n            logits = lm_head(hidden_states_normalized)\n            loss = F.cross_entropy(\n                logits.reshape(-1, logits.shape[-1]),\n                target_ids.reshape(-1)\n            )\n            # Scale loss by number of microbatches as specified\n            loss = loss * num_microbatches\n            losses.append(loss)\n        else:\n            # Send hidden states to next rank\n            _send_hidden_states(rank + 1, hidden_states.detach())\n\n    # ===== BACKWARD PHASE =====\n    for microbatch_idx in range(num_microbatches - 1, -1, -1):\n        if rank == world_size - 1:\n            # Last rank: backward from computed loss\n            losses[microbatch_idx].backward()\n        else:\n            # Other ranks: receive gradient from next rank and backpropagate\n            hidden_states_input, hidden_states_output = forward_activations[microbatch_idx]\n\n            # Receive gradient from next rank\n            microbatch_size = hidden_states_input.shape[0]\n            seq_len = hidden_states_input.shape[1]\n            grad_output = _receive_hidden_states(rank + 1, microbatch_size, seq_len,\n                                                hidden_size, device, dtype)\n\n            # Re-run forward pass through this rank's layers with gradient tracking\n            hidden_states = hidden_states_input.detach().requires_grad_(True)\n            for layer in rank_layers:\n                hidden_states = layer(hidden_states, attention_mask=None)[0]\n\n            # Backward pass to compute gradients\n            hidden_states.backward(grad_output)\n\n            # Send gradient to previous rank\n            if rank > 0:\n                _send_hidden_states(rank - 1, hidden_states_input.grad)\n\n\ndef _send_hidden_states(dest_rank, tensor):\n    \"\"\"\n    Send hidden states tensor to destination rank using P2P operations.\n    Uses torch.distributed.P2POp for point-to-point communication.\n    \"\"\"\n    if torch.distributed.get_world_size() == 1:\n        return  # No communication needed for single rank\n\n    ops = [P2POp(torch.distributed.isend, tensor, dest_rank)]\n    batch_isend_irecv(ops).pop().wait()\n\n\ndef _receive_hidden_states(src_rank, batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size, device, dtype):\n    \"\"\"\n    Receive hidden states tensor from source rank using P2P operations.\n    Creates a tensor of shape [batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size] and receives into it.\n    \"\"\"\n    if torch.distributed.get_world_size() == 1:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"Cannot receive from other rank in single-rank scenario\")\n\n    # Create tensor to receive data into\n    tensor = torch.empty(batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)\n    ops = [P2POp(torch.distributed.irecv, tensor, src_rank)]\n    batch_isend_irecv(ops).pop().wait()\n    return tensor\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
